name: taskshape
description: Cost-aware model routing for sub-agents: classify the task shape, pick the cheapest adequate model.

plugins.name: taskshape-vscode
plugins.description: VS Code agent mode: routes every runSubagent launch (suggest logs, enforce rewrites the model) with the shipped multi-provider Copilot profile table. Needs Node 22.6+.

plugins.name: taskshape-copilot
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot CLI (also Copilot CLI sessions inside VS Code): routes every task launch and, in enforce mode, rewrites model and reasoning_effort. Needs Node 22.6+.
